# Aeorch

> Free SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), Authority and AI Compatibility audit tool. Scan any website and get a scored report with actionable fixes for ranking in Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Gemini.

## Product

- [https://aeorch.com/](https://aeorch.com/): Aeorch — free SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), Authority and AI Compatibility audit tool.
- [https://aeorch.com/scan](https://aeorch.com/scan): Run a free audit of any website across SEO, AEO, GEO, Authority and AI Compatibility, with a scored report and fix recommendations.
- [https://aeorch.com/features](https://aeorch.com/features): Overview of what Aeorch checks: structured data, AI crawler access, sitemap health, authority signals, and more.
- [https://aeorch.com/about](https://aeorch.com/about): About Aeorch and why AI-era search visibility requires more than traditional SEO.
- [https://aeorch.com/contact](https://aeorch.com/contact): Contact Aeorch for support, partnerships, or higher scan volume.

## Blog

### AEO

- [10 Common AEO Mistakes Hurting Your AI Visibility](https://aeorch.com/blog/common-aeo-mistakes): From blocked AI crawlers to hidden FAQ schema, here are 10 AEO mistakes that quietly prevent AI answer engines from citing your content.
- [HowTo Schema Markup: A Complete AEO Guide](https://aeorch.com/blog/howto-schema-markup-guide): HowTo schema structures step-by-step content for AI extraction. Here's the exact JSON-LD format, required fields, and when not to use it.
- [How to Add FAQ Schema Markup (Step-by-Step)](https://aeorch.com/blog/faq-schema-markup-guide): FAQPage JSON-LD lets AI engines extract Q&A content directly. Here's the exact markup, where to put it, and common validation mistakes to avoid.
- [7 Ways AEO Differs From Traditional SEO](https://aeorch.com/blog/aeo-vs-seo-differences): AEO and SEO share some tactics but optimize for different outcomes. Here are 7 concrete differences, from ranking format to what counts as success.
- [What Is an AEO Score and How Is It Calculated?](https://aeorch.com/blog/what-is-aeo-score): An AEO score (0-100) measures FAQPage schema, question headings, HowTo markup, and AI bot access. Here's exactly how each factor is weighted.
- [Free AEO Checker: Audit Your Answer Engine Score](https://aeorch.com/blog/free-aeo-checker): A free AEO checker scans for FAQPage schema, question headings, and AI bot access, then scores it 0-100. Here's how to run one and fix what it finds.
- [What Is AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)?](https://aeorch.com/blog/what-is-aeo): AEO is optimizing your website so AI answer engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity cite you as a source. Learn what it is and how to measure your score.

### AI Compatibility

- [How to Unblock GPTBot and ClaudeBot in Robots.txt](https://aeorch.com/blog/unblock-ai-bots-robots-txt): Exact robots.txt rules to allow GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot without opening your site to every scraper. Copy-paste examples included.
- [How to Write an llms.txt File (With Examples)](https://aeorch.com/blog/how-to-write-llms-txt): llms.txt is a plain-text index of your site for AI assistants. Here's the exact format, a real example, and where to host it.
- [Is Your Site Blocked From GPTBot or ClaudeBot?](https://aeorch.com/blog/check-ai-crawler-access): A three-minute manual check plus a free automated way to see if GPTBot, ClaudeBot, or PerplexityBot are blocked from crawling your website.
- [AI Search Visibility Checker for ChatGPT & Claude](https://aeorch.com/blog/ai-search-visibility-checker): An AI search visibility checker tests whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini can access, read, and cite your website. Here's what to check and why.
- [How to Make Your Website AI-Ready (Checklist)](https://aeorch.com/blog/ai-ready-website): A step-by-step guide to making your website discoverable by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Gemini. Covers llms.txt, robots.txt, and schema markup.

### Authority

- [AI Citations: Why They're the New Backlinks](https://aeorch.com/blog/ai-citations-new-backlinks): Being cited in an AI-generated answer functions like a backlink used to — a trust signal and a traffic source. Here's how to earn AI citations.
- [Website Authority Checker: What It Measures](https://aeorch.com/blog/website-authority-checker): Authority checkers look at trust pages, author transparency, and external validation — signals AI models weigh before citing a source. Here's what to fix.

### GEO

- [Does Publish Date Affect AEO and GEO Rankings?](https://aeorch.com/blog/content-freshness-ai-search): Publish dates feed GEO's trust signals, but a stale date paired with outdated content hurts more than the date alone. How freshness actually factors in.
- [How to Improve Your GEO Score: 9 Tactics](https://aeorch.com/blog/improve-geo-score): 9 concrete tactics to raise your GEO score: authorship, dates, citations, content depth, fluency, and more, ranked by typical impact.
- [How to Get Cited by ChatGPT and Perplexity](https://aeorch.com/blog/optimize-content-for-ai-citations): Concrete content changes that correlate with higher AI citation rates: direct answers, structured Q&A, authorship, and outbound citations of your own.
- [What Is a GEO Score? Your AI Ranking Explained](https://aeorch.com/blog/what-is-geo-score): A GEO score (0-100) measures content depth, authorship, publication dates, and citations — the trust signals LLMs weigh before referencing a source.
- [What Is GEO? A Beginner's Guide to AI Search](https://aeorch.com/blog/what-is-geo): GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) means making content LLMs trust enough to cite. Here's what that means and how it differs from SEO.
- [GEO Checker: Test If AI Engines Can Cite Your Site](https://aeorch.com/blog/geo-checker): A GEO checker measures whether your content has the depth, authorship, and citations LLMs need to trust it as a source. Here's how GEO checking works.
